_meta.source: CMS QPP — Value in Primary Care MVP (M0005) + Traditional MIPS Scoring Guide, 2026 Performance Year
_meta.note: Quality/IA/Cost/PI/Population-Health sets below are the real M0005 MVP measures. CPT/HCPCS codes are included only where confidently known from the measure spec; others are left empty pending the official measure specifications.

notes: Weights are the standard (non-reweighted) 2026 case. Reweighting redistributes a category's weight when it can't be scored (e.g., PI hardship, no cost measures met).
Population Health measures are scored within the Quality category.
Cost is CMS-calculated from Medicare claims; no data submission.

mvps.title: Value in Primary Care
mvps.theme: Promoting quality care for patients to reduce the risk of diseases, disabilities, and death.

requirements.quality: Report 4 quality measures from the MVP list; at least 1 must be an outcome measure (or a high-priority measure if no outcome applies). Full 12-month performance period.
requirements.improvementActivities: Report 1 improvement activity from the MVP list. Activities no longer carry assigned weights.
requirements.cost: No submission — CMS calculates all MVP cost measures from Medicare claims; scored where the case minimum is met.
requirements.promotingInteroperability: Submit the required PI measures (same as traditional MIPS); subject to automatic reweighting / hardship exceptions.
requirements.populationHealth: No submission — CMS calculates from administrative claims; scored within Quality.
